title: When is the call job done?
hook: The call ends at minute 30. Is that when the job is done?

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: that follow-up work such as writing notes is part of the job, so the work ends when the wrap-up ends, not when the call ends

misconception: The job is over when the call ends.
objective: Include a required follow-up block in total calendar capacity.
